text:
Alex L.: Following up on the observability schema RFC — propose a conservative migration plan for trace/metric/log schema evolution + retention tiers. TL;DR: ingesters accept old+new fields, tag shipped events with `schema_version`, store raw payloads for 7d, normalized proto for 90d, archive compacted aggregates for 365d. Thoughts?

Maria P.: +1 to `schema_version`. What's our backfill cost for normalizing 6 months of traces? Also we need deterministic sampling for cost attribution.

Cheng Wu: Backfill estimate ~12 GPU-hours + S3 egress (rough). Suggest we implement an ingest-time compatibility layer: mapping rules (rename/flatten), emit warnings, and write both raw + normalized to the buffer so downstream can catch up.

Samir K.: For billing tags, avoid putting PII into tags. Proposal: `route_id`, `customer_plan`, `cost_tag` with hashed identifiers. Deterministic sampling = `trace_id % N` so it's replayable. :thumbsup:

Alex L.: Good call on hashing. Example ingest mapping config we could start with:

```yaml
map_rules:
  - from: request.user_id
    to: meta.user_hash
    transform: sha256 | truncate:8
  - from: trace.http.path
    to: route
  - from: trace.metadata.app_version
    to: tags.app_v
```

Cheng Wu: That looks fine. Also—keep `sampling_policy_version` and `schema_version` on the envelope so replays are deterministic. CI should run a compatibility test suite that replays a few weeks of traffic through the compat-layer.

ingest-bot: deploy pipeline/compat-layer v0.2 rolled to canary (us-west-1). 4/4 healthy.

Maria P.: Can we expose a fast path for cost queries? Suggest pre-aggregating per-route/day into a compact table (retention 2y) and keeping raw traces for ad-hoc joins for 90d.

Cheng Wu: Agree. Pre-agg keys = (date, route, customer_hash, sampling_policy_version). Store counts, total_tokens, compute-est_cost. Keeps cardinality low.

Samir K.: Also, make sure sampling is annotatable: wire field `sampled_for_cost` boolean so downstream knows which spans are canonical for billing. Will draft policy doc.

Alex L.: Action items: 1) Cheng to draft compat-layer PR + CI test. 2) Maria to spec pre-agg table cols + retention. 3) Samir to write sampling policy doc (include replay tests). I'll schedule a short sync Wed 10:00am. @everyone

Maria P.: Sounds good — I'll add rough schema to the ticket and include cost/backfill estimate.

Samir K.: I'll add a small PoC for deterministic sampling in `ingest-sim` this week.

Cheng Wu: I'll open the PR and link the CI tests. Thanks.
